title: Mithy Kyu Ja Rahay Hai Qadmon
body:
Mithy Kyu Ja Rahay Ha Qadmon Ky Nishaan Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaayad Meri Qaza Ka Ha Yeh Samaan Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Dam Tootny Sy Pehly Ik Baar Hee Sahee Me
Tujhy Saamny Betha Kar Sunloo Azaan Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab mujhko lenay ao Asghar ko saath lana
Kaisy Jhulao Uska Jhoola Veeran Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri Wajah e Ibadat Tere Qadam Nishan Ha
Meri Namaz Akbar Mera Quran Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri behan sakina ka khaas har ghdi tum
Rakhna khayal Us me ha meri jan akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab Ja baasay ha teri, jageer karbala me
Mera ha ik sahara, khaali maqaan akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ik Tere Baad Akbar, Kuch Na Dikhayi Deta
Mere liye Toh Tu, Ha Sara Jahan Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekha Ha Meh Nay Nana Manzar Ajeeb Karbal
Baba Kay Bazoono Me, Zakhmi Jawan Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri behan Sakina, ka khaas har ghari tum
Rakhna khayal us me, ha meri jan Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Adil Kee Ha Duayen, Teri Karbala Woh Jayen
Tere Matami Ha Jitnay, Teray Nohakhawn Akbar
